sub_problems.fills: a CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH launch that goes through the shebang resolver and exits 126 when it cannot run
sub_problems.what: in bin/cairn.py _bus, build the override's argv with _argv_for(Path(mouth)); say the script name and return 126 when it is None or the launch raises OSError
sub_problems.why: Outline 5.4.3.8: one dispatcher serves both platforms; _run already gives a shebang script its shell on Windows, and the mouth override is launched bare, so Windows dies WinError 193 / exit 70.
